The '''Helthen Company''' was a heavy-duty equipment provider. Some of their products were [[thermo-converter]]s to maintain electrical power, such as the one they installed on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] for [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]].
